Callout.Name: Shots into a Building
Callout.Message: Shots fired at a building, windows broken.

Script.Line: It came through the window while I was sat there.
I am on the floor, I have been on the floor since.
My neighbour has got glass in the front room as well.

Lines.Approach: Windows are out and no casualties, and a car left fast. That is your starting point.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
